name: Namegawa (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Namegawa town emblem in white: a ring crossed by a horizontal bar enclosing three vertical bars.
history: Municipal flag of Namegawa, a town in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 17 December 1963.

features.role: Namegawa town emblem — a ring crossed by a horizontal bar enclosing three vertical bars
